messages.subject: Error in colour_ramp(colours) : could not find function "muted"
parts:
在此输入代码...
p3 <- ggplot(housing,
             aes(x = State,
                 y = Home.Price.Index)) + 
  theme(legend.position="top",
        axis.text=element_text(size = 6))

(p4 <- p3 + geom_point(aes(color = Date),
                       alpha = 0.5,
                       size = 1.5,

p4 +
  scale_color_continuous(name="",

                         labels = c("'76", "'94", "'13"),
